synopsis: The corpus identifies IEC 31010:2019, alongside ISO 31000:2018, as documenting risk-management practice [f16341]. The glossary specifies that these standards document risk-assessment techniques forming the basis of the risk register [f15354]. Chapter 12 connects them explicitly to risk-register and risk-matrix practice, reinforcing their role in planning and presenting the plan [f9669].

relations.note: The glossary explains the risk-assessment basis of the risk-register practice cited in Chapter 12.
Chapter 12 specifies risk-register and risk-matrix practice within the standards’ broader risk-management role.
Adds risk-assessment techniques and their role as the basis of the risk register.
